test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pankaj sells an article and earns a profit of 55 percent. What will be the ratio of cost price and selling price?
solution:
**Given:**

The profit percentage is 55 percentage.

**Concept:**

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be C and selling price be S

According to the question

⇒ 55={S-Cover C}times 100

⇒ 11={S-Cover C}times 20

⇒ 11C = 20S - 20C

⇒ 11C + 20C = 20S

⇒ 31C = 20S

⇒ {Cover S}={20over31}

**∴ The required result will be 20 : 31.**
